title: DiverValue-Bench: A Benchmark and Fine-Tuning Framework for Aligning Large Language Models with Diverse Human Values
abstract: arXiv:2509.08022v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse human values is essential for safe and effective deployment, yet existing benchmarks often overlook cultural and demographic variation. We introduce DiverValue-Bench, a population-aware benchmark for evaluating multi-dimensional value alignment across 74 countries/regions. It contains 23,763 quality-controlled instances derived from PRISM user feedback and audited through large-scale human validation, with fine-grained value labels, personalized questions, contrastive reference answers, and rich demographic metadata. Using DiverValue-Bench, we evaluate representative LLMs and reveal substantial geographic and demographic disparities that are masked by aggregate performance. translated_title: DiverValue-Bench：一个用于将大型语言模型与多元人类价值观对齐的基准与微调框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：将大型语言模型（LLMs）与多元人类价值观对齐对于安全有效的部署至关重要，但现有基准往往忽视文化和人口统计差异。我们引入了DiverValue-Bench，一个面向人口的基准，用于评估74个国家/地区的多维价值观对齐。它包含23,763个质量控制过的实例，这些实例源自PRISM用户反馈，并通过大规模人工验证进行审核，具有细粒度的价值观标签、个性化问题、对比性参考答案和丰富的人口统计元数据。利用DiverValue-Bench，我们评估了代表性LLMs，并揭示了被聚合性能掩盖的显著地理和人口统计差异。我们进一步表明，使用低秩适应（LoRA）和直接偏好优化（DPO）的轻量级基于偏好的微调，能显著提高领域内的价值观对齐，同时保持一致性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个覆盖74个国家/地区的多元价值观对齐基准，并证明轻量级微调能有效改善跨地域和人口统计的价值观一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a population-aware benchmark across 74 countries/regions for multi-dimensional value alignment and shows that lightweight fine-tuning effectively improves cross-geographic and demographic value consistency.
